text.p: HighwayMaster Corp said on Monday that it has agreed to form an exclusive strategic business alliance with Motorola and Prince Corp to develop and provide AutoLink, a safety, security, information and convenience service for motorists.
AutoLink provides a communications link from the car to an information services complex to provide emergency and other roadside assistance.
The product would also be able to unlock car doors when the keys have been locked inside, track a stolen vehicle or let an automotive service center dial directly into an engine, the company said.
HighwayMaster shares were trading up 2 at 20-5/8.
Motorola would develop and provide the in-vehicle electronics. With Prince, it would also provide sales, services and marketing support, HighwayMaster said.
Prince was recently bought by Johnson Controls Corp.
